## Overview

- **Name**: Odoo Application Server
- **Description**: Odoo 18.0 server process serving the web client, JSON-RPC/XML-RPC and HTTP routes, with custom addons loaded in-process.
- **Type**: Web Application / API
- **Class**: Compute
- **Technology**: Python 3.12 (`python:3.12-slim`), Odoo 18.0, threaded mode (no separate workers)
- **Deployment**: Docker Compose service (single replica, dev topology)
- **Source**: In-repo (image traced to `Dockerfile`)
- **Inferred?**: No — mapped from IaC

## Purpose

Runs the Odoo platform at runtime: upstream core (`odoo/`), upstream addons (`addons/`) and the project's `custom_addons/` all execute inside this one process. It serves the browser web client, portal, and the generic ORM RPC endpoints, and persists business data to the PostgreSQL container and attachments to the filestore volume. It is the only deployable unit that runs project code. There are no queues, caches or separate workers in this topology.

## Components Deployed Here

- [`../components/c4-component-sale-credit-limit-warning.md`](../components/c4-component-sale-credit-limit-warning.md) — Odoo addon that warns salespeople on draft/sent sale orders when customer exposure approaches or exceeds the credit limit

Note: the entity aggregator listed `SaleOrder` as an orphan (no `container_hint` in the c4-code doc). It is an `_inherit` extension of upstream `sale.order` adding non-stored computed fields `credit_warning_message` and `credit_warning_level`. It declares no stored columns, so persistence of `sale.order` itself belongs to the PostgreSQL container via the upstream `sale` addon. See [`c4-entities.md`](../c4-entities.md) for orphans.

## Deployment Details

- **Build Context**: repository root (`.`); Dockerfile `COPY . .` places the whole source tree in `/opt/odoo`
- **Image / Runtime**: `python:3.12-slim` with build tooling, Node `rtlcss`, `node-less`, Chromium; Python deps from `requirements.txt` plus `websocket-client`
- **Exposed Ports**: 8069 (published `8069:8069`)
- **Environment Variables**: `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE` (set in compose). Odoo options come from `docker/odoo.conf`: `addons_path`, `data_dir`, `admin_passwd`, `db_host`, `db_port`, `db_user`, `db_password`, `dev_mode` (names only; the file holds plaintext dev credentials)
- **Secrets / Mounted Volumes**: `docker/odoo.conf` to `/etc/odoo/odoo.conf` (ro); named volume `odoo-filestore` to `/var/lib/odoo`
- **Health Check**: none defined
- **Scaling**: fixed, 1 replica, threaded mode
- **Resource Profile**: no limits declared
- **Region(s)**: n/a (local Docker)

## Local Development

- **Run locally**: `docker compose up --build` (command in compose: `python odoo-bin -c /etc/odoo/odoo.conf`); use `docker compose watch` for live sync

- **Build image**: `docker compose build odoo`
